NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No. 2 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 02 of 1974, I, Anura Karunathilake, Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing, do hereby approve the acquisition of the immobile properties of the allotment of land described in the following schedule, as it is required by the said Board, for the construction of the Oﬃ cer-in-Charge Oﬃ ce (Payagala).
